label: Climate Stress
definition: Environmental stress from heat flooding storms or climate variability

label: Infrastructure Capacity
definition: Capacity of built systems to absorb or buffer stress

label: Public Health Risk
definition: Risk of population-level harm under system stress

label: Institutional Response
definition: Agency coordination policy implementation and emergency response

label: Community Trust
definition: Trust between communities institutions and response systems

label: Resource Allocation
definition: Distribution of funding staff and material support

label: Adaptive Learning
definition: Capacity to revise action based on evidence and feedback

label: System Resilience
definition: Emergent ability of the system to maintain adapt or transform under stress

label: Metadata Quality
definition: Completeness and reliability of structured knowledge metadata

label: Retrieval Quality
definition: Ability of users and AI systems to retrieve grounded relevant knowledge
